In return, you will receive a gross monthly salary of up to €2,700, work day shifts, and have the opportunity to secure a permanent contract with the employer after demonstrating your skills. Apply today!Your responsibilities include:    - Processing materials by cutting, punching, sealing, and pressing    - Operating production machines and using hand tools    - Performing quality inspections on finished products    - Supporting various production departments    - Working together with colleagues to keep the production process running smoothly    - Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized workplaceWhat's in it for you?    - Gross monthly salary between €2,600 and €2,700    - Travel allowance according to the employer's reimbursement scheme    - Pension accrual through Manpower    - Temporary employment contract through Manpower    - Fast-track opportunity for a permanent contract with the employer based on good performance    - Full-time or part-time position of 32 to 40 hours per week    - Thorough on-the-job training and opportunities to further develop your technical skills    - Technical insight or an affinity for technology    - Accurate working style and attention to detail    - Motivation to learn and develop your skills    - Ability to work independently as well as in a team    - Good command of the English language, as English is the primary language spoken on the work floorReady to take the next step as a Technical Production Employee in Echt? Apply today, and Manpower will contact you as soon as possible after receiving your application.

Would you like to join the Happiness Industry?We are looking for a Reservations Agent / Reserveringsagent to join the opening team of a new hotel in Rotterdam (Netherlands). What will you be responsible for?·       Managing individual and group reservations through phone, email, and online channels.·       Ensuring accurate data entry, room allocation, and reservation follow‑up.·       Providing detailed information about rates, availability, services, and hotel facilities.·       Handling modifications, cancellations, and special requests.·       Coordinating with Front Office, Revenue Management, and Sales to optimize occupancy and revenue.·       Assisting in the creation and implementation of reservation procedures for the hotel opening.·       Ensuring compliance with brand standards and delivering excellent customer service.·       Supporting reporting tasks and maintaining reservation records. What are we looking for?·       Previous experience as Reservations Agent or in Front Office roles.·       Experience in hotel openings is highly valued.·       Strong communication and organizational skills.·       Fluency in English and Dutch; Spanish is highly valued.·       Knowledge of PMS and reservation systems is a plus.·       Customer‑focused mindset and attention to detail. What do we offer?·       Up to 50% discount in our 4/5 hotels worldwide.·       Free and unlimited online training with The Power Business School.·       Access to our Employee Club with exclusive advantages and discounts.·       Referral program rewarding your recommendations with hotel nights.·       The opportunity to join the reservations opening of a new international hotel.Functie-eisen:.
